summary: FOODbakēd Pass 2 Driver Dispatch — full P0/P1/P2 regression. Added /app/backend/tests/test_food_dispatch_bridge_pass2_ext.py (9 tests) on top of the existing test_food_dispatch_bridge.py (7 tests) → 16/16 passing. Covered: delivery_dispatched audit event on happy preparing (P0); anonymous customer logs delivery_failed(anonymous_customer_cannot_receive_delivery) while partner PATCH still 200 (P0); dispatch idempotency + tenant isolation + pickup orders skip + missing-coords delivery_failed + customer-side PIN hiding (all P0 — pre-existing suite); confirm-pickup wrong PIN→422, pre-assignment→409, correct PIN→200 flipping food_orders.status='out_for_delivery' + express_bookings.status='picked_up' + out_for_delivery event (P1); SEND tracking transition_status('delivered') on a food_delivery booking cascades food_orders.status='delivered' + delivered_at + delivered event + idempotent on replay (P1); parcel booking delivered via same helper does NOT touch food_orders (P1 non-FOOD cascade safety); dynamic vehicle 1→bike, 10→scooter, 25→three_wheeler (P2). Frontend: logged into partner portal (qa-burger@test.example / QaBurger123!), navigated /partner/food/orders → preparing tab, verified 36 delivery sub-cards rendered inline with correct testids and FR copy 'Recherche d’un livreur / Nous notifions les livreurs disponibles…' (monolingual, no bilingual '·' concat). Customer tracking page /foodbaked/orders/{oid}/track verified for FD-7D0960 — food-track-page wrapper + food-track-order-number='FD-7D0960' + full 6-stage pipeline (placed/accepted/preparing/ready/out_for_delivery/delivered) with current 3 stages highlighted; FR labels exact match ('Commande passée','Acceptée par le restaurant','En préparation','Prête pour le livreur','En livraison','Livrée') and EN labels exact match ('Order placed','Restaurant accepted','Preparing','Ready for pickup','On the way','Delivered'); food-track-driver sub-card renders with 'Nous cherchons un livreur à proximité' / 'We’re looking for a nearby driver' + 'Looking for a driver…' badge; pickup PIN never surfaces on the customer side. After directly flipping express_bookings → driver_assigned (per the review note), the partner delivery endpoint exposes pickup_pin='7020' + vehicle_code='bike' as spec'd — same endpoint powers the Live Driver card.
critical_code_review_comments: modules/food/orders.py L440-456: dispatch bridge trigger is wrapped in its own try/except DispatchError + its own session.commit() AFTER the main PATCH commit — kitchen flow is correctly isolated from dispatch failure. Audit events delivery_dispatched / delivery_failed are both emitted via _log_event with actor_role='system'. Good.

modules/food/orders.py L550-600: confirm-pickup uses two separate UPDATEs on express_bookings + food_orders in one transaction (no inner commit between them), then logs 'out_for_delivery' event + commits + fires WS. Status gate 'driver_assigned|arriving' is enforced; wrong PIN cleanly returns 422 before any mutation. Correct.

modules/food/orders.py L607-637: cascade_delivered_from_express uses SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on food_orders + short-circuit on status='delivered' → idempotent as spec'd; verified by second-call assertion in test_cascade_delivered_flips_food_order_and_is_idempotent.

modules/express/tracking.py L130-137: cascade is correctly gated on both booking.food_order_id AND booking.source_module == 'food' AND new_status=='delivered'. Parcel bookings short-circuit, verified by test_parcel_delivered_does_not_touch_food_orders.

modules/food/dispatch_bridge.py L63-71: thresholds exactly match spec (≤8 bike, 9-20 scooter, 21+ three_wheeler). food_delivery_public with include_pin flag correctly segregates partner vs customer visibility (verified by test_customer_track_hides_pickup_pin).

frontend FoodOrderTrackPage.jsx + PartnerOrdersPage.jsx: all required data-testids present (food-track-page, food-track-order-number, food-track-stage-*, food-track-driver, partner-order-driver-{oid}, partner-order-pickup-pin-{oid}, partner-order-pickup-input-{oid}, partner-order-pickup-confirm-{oid}, partner-order-pickup-err-{oid}). FR/EN labels are 100% monolingual per i18n locale — no '·' bilingual concatenations seen in either track or driver sub-cards.

Minor nit (NOT a bug): the Partner Orders 'preparing' tab shows 103 orders including some orphan 'placed' badges at the top on refresh/race — this is just the shared seed data from previous iterations rendering with stale status badges while the server-side filter is correct (tab_count=103 matches the real preparing count). First test run surfaced the correct FD-7D0960 row at top of preparing; second run showed older placed rows at top, suggesting a mild sort inconsistency on reload. Does not affect Pass 2 scope.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on P1 scope (partner Live Driver card + customer tracking + FR/EN parity verified live)

Dispatch bridge, confirm-pickup PIN flow, delivered cascade (incl. idempotency + non-FOOD safety), dynamic vehicle selection, customer tracking page, and partner Live Driver card are all production-ready. The partner Orders 'preparing' tab occasionally renders stale `placed` badges at the top on reload (count is correct, individual row statuses may be slightly behind) — not a blocker for Pass 2 but worth revisiting if partner UX gets a polish pass.
